reason: Development-time tooling only. braces reaches the tree through @graphql-codegen/cli > micromatch and @simulacrum/foundation-simulator > http-proxy-middleware > micromatch, which pin braces@3.0.3. The brace patterns come from code generation and test-simulator configuration, not from untrusted runtime input; a pull request can change that configuration and fail its own CI run. The advisory (stack exhaustion on deeply nested patterns) covers every release up to 3.0.3, the latest published, so there is no patched release to move to. Rationale and exposure: docs/dependency-policy-exception-braces-nested-patterns.md. Remove this entry once a patched braces exists or micromatch drops braces 3.
